component.name: Notation
component.summary: Handwritten notes, PDF annotation, formulas and flashcards

description.p: Notation is a note-taking and PDF-annotation app for people who write by hand and study. Pen, highlighter and shapes, text boxes, tables and formulas live in the same note, and handwriting becomes searchable text on your device.
Study with flashcards and spaced repetition, quizzes, and a maths checker for handwritten working.

ul.li: Annotate PDFs and export them with a text layer
Folders, tags, search, a calendar with tasks and reminders
AI features run on the device by default
Optional live collaboration and sync, end-to-end encrypted
No account, no ads, no analytics
